scope: P0-4 local project review bridge: trusted UI callback/terminal confirmation to persisted final dimension lock and CollectionJob readback

checks.verified_by: core worker; included in root final full regression
root; included in final full regression

checks.check: Changed Markdown local links and code fences
checks.result: all local links resolve; code fences balanced

cli.terminal_requirement: Both stdin and stderr report isatty; no --yes or piped approval; hints and questions on stderr, one JSON response on stdout.
cli.input: Explicit DiscoveryProposal, selected_ids and versioned dimension library/selection; not automatic discovery or recommendation.
cli.result: locked/rejected/failed with review_id, scope_locked, jobs, record_path, error_code and fixed research_ready=false; preflight failures use a ToolResult error envelope.
cli.not_model_callable: Approval is not registered in ToolRegistry.

flow: Read current profile and draft dimensions
Display proposed selection and accept only the fresh competitors token
Design and persist final dimensions using existing review APIs
Display final dimensions and accept only the fresh dimensions token
Persist lock and reread complete question/decision/approval/proposal/Markdown/lock chain
prepare_collection_jobs readback and persist/reread final result
token_binding: Current ProjectContext digest including full profile SHA-256
Complete request digest including selected candidate IDs/library/field selection/readers/rationale
For final dimension approval: proposal and actual Markdown digests
confirmation_and_persistence.approval_timestamps: Generated from the current UTC clock, never taken from input approval JSON.
confirmation_and_persistence.concurrency: Cooperating local reviews serialized with nonblocking POSIX flock.
confirmation_and_persistence.safe_file_policy: Regular single-link files, no symlinks or multi-link hardlinks; bounded reads with no-follow open. Audit records published exclusively without replacing existing records.
confirmation_and_persistence.success_condition: Actual persisted artifacts and final result read back and match expected values; lock existence alone is insufficient.
confirmation_and_persistence.storage_failure_boundary: Failed writes may retain partial dimension/lock artifacts and refuse silent retry. record_path is an intended location and may not exist if storage is unavailable. No cross-file transaction or automatic recovery claimed.

verified_cases: Real existing confirm_competitors/design_dimensions/write_dimensions/confirm_dimensions/prepare_collection_jobs API chain succeeds and can be independently reread.
Configured readers, library core subset/extensions and selected candidates are preserved; user-provided proposal import is not research evidence.
Ambiguous answers, empty input, EOF and KeyboardInterrupt reject instead of approving.
Tokens from another stage/review/session cannot authorize the current question.
Changed profile, candidate request, dimensions, proposal, approval or previous decision record cannot yield locked success.
Existing dimension reviews/locks are not overwritten; concurrent reviews return busy.
Malformed, oversized, duplicate-key, non-UTF-8 or extra approval fields are rejected.

Project review artifacts reject symlinks, non-regular files and multi-link hardlinks; the hardlink fixture preserves both original paths before any question. CLI proposal input rejects symlinks/non-regular files and is bounded/read-only.
Covered write/readback/result-publication faults produce failed results with no delivered jobs, and never retain a recoverable contradictory success receipt.
Temporary-record exclusive publication does not remove an existing record owned by another call.
CLI keeps stdout as one JSON and refuses noninteractive approval before reading input or creating project state.
Default product-name analysis remains pending_module without invoking this optional project review flow.

closed_findings.finding: Later confirmation could alter an earlier accepted audit decision without blocking final lock.
closed_findings.fix: Immediately reread questions/decisions and recheck both stages plus derived artifacts before final success.
closed_findings.probe_result: failed / REVIEW_RECORD_CHANGED, jobs empty, no canonical lock, failed result persisted.

closed_findings.finding: A cleanup OSError after result publication could return failed while a locked success receipt remained on disk.
closed_findings.fix: Track publication ownership; undo this call target on post-publication error, clean temporary file and persist the failed result after storage recovers. Preserve preexisting targets.
closed_findings.probe_result: Returned and persisted failed/scope_locked=false; no pending file.

closed_findings.finding: A draft dimensions hardlink could allow in-place writing to affect another path sharing its inode.
closed_findings.fix: Require st_nlink==1 in lstat policy and opened-file fstat checks.
closed_findings.probe_result: Refused before prompting; original bytes at both linked paths unchanged; no lock/jobs.

independent_tests: 4 targeted tests passed after hardlink fix: hardlink rejection, full successful flow, preserve existing record, publication cleanup failure
independent_review.additional_probe: Actual resolved tmp directory: os.link window has nlink=2, temporary removal restores nlink=1, final record load succeeds without pending file.

authorization_and_execution_boundary.trusted_callback: Application-side trust assumption; not proof of human or Codex user-message identity.
authorization_and_execution_boundary.terminal_test_inputs: Synthetic TTY surfaces and input callbacks only; no actual business approval session was run.

roadmap: docs/roadmap.md maps all 11 user priorities to actual code and remaining acceptance. SaaS configuration and pending guidance are existing partial capabilities; model-backed extraction is a dependency of general Research.
